run_pushing_loop: run the locobot pushing manipulation loop that segments objects and pushes them with the arm
run_filter_points: run the filter_points function to filter point cloud data by z height and x-y bounds
run_segment_objects: run the segment_objects function to cluster 2D points using DBSCAN and return labels
run_draw_segments: run the draw_segments function to visualize clustered point cloud segments and save plots
run_sample_pt: run the sample_pt function to sample a random edge point on a segmented object for pushing
